question.text: Conflict of Interest at Fund-Constituent level of a Cat III AIF includes:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.1.2, employees shall not solicit gifts, hard/soft commissions when representing the fund. The Trap: Daily logs and NIFTY-only investment are unrelated to conflict of interest definitions. Cross-Exam Context: Similar anti-gift rules in SEBI (PIT) and broker conduct codes. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Log all gift receipts promptly — threshold-based reporting is usually required internally.
